targets.summary: The @onlyCUDA decorator isn't needed on the new test. Remove it so the test also runs on other devices.
targets.evidence: Before: line 1025 `@onlyCUDA` above `@dtypes(...)` on `test_foreach_max_with_different_tensor_sizes_and_negative_values`. Merged: the `@onlyCUDA` line is removed, so the test now starts with `@dtypes(*floating_types_and(torch.half, torch.bfloat16))` and runs on all devices. A new test added later in the file still uses `@onlyCUDA`, but that is a different test.
